verdict.rationale: Reflect's AI palette lets users type natural-language prompts to summarize, extract action items, or chat with notes, and this can be saved as reusable custom prompts (reflect-docs-5, reflect-docs-20, reflect-docs-31, reflect-docs-32, reflect-docs-7, reflect-docs-28). However, this is limited to content Q&A/generation within notes, not general natural-language control of app actions—actual command execution (e.g. deep links) relies on structured URL parameters, not free-form language (reflect-docs-38). Missing for 10: evidence of natural-language commands driving broader app actions (navigation, task creation, integrations) beyond note content Q&A, and any independent/hands-on validation of the AI palette's command-following reliability.
